E0349

`#Meta` written outside binding/function position

What

`#Meta` written outside binding/function position

Why

The registered parse rule applies here

Fix

Place `#Meta` on a binding or function declaration.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0349: tests/ui/meta_on_expression.stderr.

Error [jet.MetaNotAllowedHere]: `#Meta` attaches to a binding or function
  --> tests/ui/meta_on_expression.jet:2:14
    |
  2 |     speed :: #Meta(category: "Movement") 10
    |              ^^^^^
 Why: `#Meta` is a tooling fact about a named source item; expressions do not carry it
 Fix: Move `#Meta(...)` before a binding or function, or remove it
